Luanshi contributors extracted garment and sleeve faces from these author-published
COLLADA meshes: m_pants_tunic_long, m_armor_tunic_long, m_tunic_short. They refitted
the body and arm weights to the river company, kept the artist UV seams, and adapted
lamellar_01_lacquered_01, lamellar_02_lacquered_01 and tunic_01_01 into a shared
cel-colour atlas. For the tied field issues, the regular coat uses the Han tunic
skin. The separate gores, fitted collar and girdle fit the exposed source
waist sections and move with the existing field hips and legs. The editable
cut and skin weights are in tools/art/tailor_field_coats.py.
The output consists solely of clothing adaptations. There is no
Wildfire code, animation file, logo or material from a retail game in the conversion.
Source retrieval and verified upstream blob identifiers: tools/art/import_garrison_issues.py.
No affiliation or endorsement is implied.
